summary: Learn to review, structure and track research agreements with practical templates and agreement exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Research contracts training helps research administrators, contract officers and project leads structure and administer agreements through a project lifecycle. Participants practise scoping agreements and statements of work, reviewing clauses and budget schedules, and tracking obligations, approvals and changes with practical templates. The foundation course also covers intellectual property, publication, data and research-material terms; specialist legal interpretation and jurisdiction-specific advice are outside its scope.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or administer research agreements and need practical ways to coordinate project obligations, payments, deliverables and changes.
prerequisites: No prior contract-drafting experience is required. Familiarity with research projects or grant-funded work can help you apply the examples.
